items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Did he ever tell you anything about Marnie? ... He may not have known that you were kin to Marnie or that. INTERVIEWEE: No, I never did know that. I never did know that.

ctx.x: Did he ever tell you anything about Marnie? No. Well, they used to work together, you know? Yeah. He may not have known that you were kin to Marnie or that.
No, I never did know that. I never did know that.
